notes.title: Check out our newest game: shapez 2 is 25% off!
notes.content:
Did you check out our newest game already? You can now pick up shapez 2 with [b]25% off[/b], the deepest discount so far!

shapez 2 is a top-down factory-building game where you extract and process geometric shapes. Each shape is its own set of building-blocks that your factories can take apart, stack, paint and put back together in unique ways. Build and automate to produce distinct shapes and solve the production challenge of each goal.

Automate the processing of abstract geometric shapes into more complex ones by cutting, rotating, stacking, painting and more. Deliver distinct shapes to unlock new technologies and expand your factory’s capabilities. Learn, improve, rebuild and solve logistical challenges to design the most efficient shape production lines.

Discount is available until November 25th!

notes.title: Preview: So, whats next?
notes.content:
You might have noticed that there haven't been many updates since the release of YORG.io on steam. This is, in fact, not because I have abandoned it - actually the opposite is the case: I'm actively working on a [b]entirely new version[/b] of it!

It will be called [b]YORG.io 3[/b] (Since the current version is 2.x) and will be available on desktop as well as mobile. While its similar to YORG.io, it has entirely new graphics and much more content (achievements, different maps, powerups, many more zombies, etc.).

I also want to implement multiplayer, but I can't promise this will happen in the initial release.

If this sounds cool, you are invited to dm me on discord (tobspr#5407) and I'll send you a beta invite!

If you are wondering why I am not simply doing this as an update to the existing YORG.io: First of all, I didn't want to modify the original game that much, because there are a lot of people who like it exactly the way it is. Additionally, the codebase is super bloated, and I wanted to switch to a custom engine with better performance and start from ground up. 

If you have any questions, I'd be happy to answer them!

Cheers,
Tobias

notes.title: YORG.io Standalone is coming on May 23th!
notes.content:
I'm super happy to announce that the YORG.io Standalone will be released on the 23th of May!

The standalone features many improvements over the online YORG.io:

- No advertisements
[b]- Improved performance and less lag[/b]
- Synchronize your savegames accross all of your devices using SteamCloud
- Quality of live improvements like an improved start screen

And if you are wondering: You will of course be able to [b]use your old savegames[/b] in the standalone - I will make another annoucement soon explaining how to import them.
